name: playwright-cucumber-bdd-project

scripts.test: cucumber-js --require-module ts-node/register --require src/hooks/hooks.ts --require src/steps/*.ts --format json:reports/cucumber-report.json --format html:reports/cucumber-report.html --format pretty
